fields.postcondition: a string produced by SerializeToExternalString for unaltered bytes always reverses successfully to the original byte sequence, since both directions compute the 12-bit checksum over the unobfuscated byte values
fields.response: decode the URL-safe Modified Base64 characters and invert the bit-inversion obfuscation to recover the payload bytes, recompute the 12-bit checksum over the de-obfuscated bytes, and reject an invalid external key string (when the recomputed checksum does not equal the leading two checksum characters or a character falls outside the encoding alphabet) by throwing an exception
fields.subject: StringExtensions
fields.trigger: a caller decodes an external key string via SerializeFromExternalString
